name: Aesthetic and dermatology clinics

problems.words: Instagram DMs pile up and half the leads never get a reply
quick_ideas: Check how long last week's DMs waited for a first reply, so the delay is measured
Give DMs to one person at fixed times rather than the busy receptionist, so they have an owner.

workzap_build.text: one inbox for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp and website forms with response timers and booking outcome, measured daily per branch.

problems.free_stops: Routing and response rules are set in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count yesterday's unanswered Instagram messages at closing time, so you can see how many potential bookings are waiting.
Give one team member two fixed message-check times daily and one written handover list, so replies stop getting lost at reception.

problems.words: We spend a lot on Meta ads and can't say which ones bring bookings
quick_ideas: Ask every new booking where they heard of you, so you get a rough split
List the campaigns running now, so each can be matched to bookings.

workzap_build.text: a code or link per campaign and influencer collab, tied to enquiries, bookings and revenue automatically.

problems.ask_first: How many campaigns or collabs are running this month?
problems.free_stops: How codes are set up per campaign is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare this week's new bookings with the source each caller mentions, so the adverts bringing enquiries are easier to spot.
Keep one notebook at the booking desk for every new enquiry source, so bookings and promotion activity get matched in one place.

problems.words: Clients buy laser packages and never finish them
quick_ideas: List open packages with sessions left and last visit, so stalled ones are visible
Contact those overdue for their next session, with their permission, so they rebook.

workzap_build.text: loyalty_repeat — a package ledger with next-session reminders sent automatically to consenting clients, with completion tracked by branch.

problems.ask_first: Do packages have an expiry date?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and rebooking flow are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count open laser packages with missed return dates this week, so you can see how much paid work is sitting unfinished.
Give one person a fixed weekly slot to review unfinished packages and pass a rebooking list to the front desk, so follow-up happens regularly.

problems.words: I don't know how much unused package value is sitting on our books
quick_ideas: Total sessions sold but not used across all packages, so the figure is known
Ask your accountant how to record it, so the books reflect it properly.

workzap_build.text: You would see unused package value, bookings and revenue by service and branch, refreshed every morning.

problems.ask_first: Do you sell memberships as well as packages?
problems.free_stops: The liability calculation is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count unused sessions across active packages and note their selling price this week, so the clinic can see what is still owed.
Keep one package notebook at reception and update remaining sessions after each visit, so unused value is tracked in one place.

problems.words: Staff give discounts in DMs that the counter doesn't know about
quick_ideas: Put current offers with start and end dates in one shared list, so DM team and counter match
Name who may give a discount, so there is one rule.

workzap_build.text: a central offer and price list pushed to the counter and DM team, with discount and free touch-up approvals logged by role.

problems.ask_first: Do both branches run the same offers?
problems.free_stops: Approval levels are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare this week's DM discounts with what the counter charged on the same bookings, so mismatches are easy to spot.
Keep one written offers list at the counter and make one person update it, so DM promises match what reception collects.

problems.words: Injectable stock doesn't match what was used
quick_ideas: Count injectable stock against this week's treatments once, so the gap is known
Keep high-value stock in one locked fridge, so access is limited.

workzap_build.text: an injectables and product register with lot, expiry and usage entered per treatment reference, flagging mismatches and near-expiry stock.

problems.ask_first: Who records usage at the chair today?
problems.free_stops: Register fields and checks are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare opened injectable boxes with this week's treatment entries once, so you can see whether the stock gap is small or serious.
Give one person the end-of-day injectable count and one notebook for every issue and return, so stock handling stays consistent.

problems.words: Leased laser charges per shot and I can't reconcile the bill
quick_ideas: Note the machine's shot counter at the start and end of each day for a week, so usage is on record
Compare it with the vendor bill, so differences show.

workzap_build.text: cash_reconciliation — daily device counter entries by phone with a monthly check against the vendor bill.

problems.ask_first: Is the device leased or on revenue-share?
problems.free_stops: The reconciliation method is in the solution document; lease terms are for your lawyer.

extra_ideas.text: Write down the laser shot counter at opening and closing for one week, so billed usage can be checked against clinic activity.
Make one person note daily shot counts in one notebook beside the machine, so usage records are ready before the bill arrives.

problems.words: Therapists argue about commission on package sales
quick_ideas: Put the commission rule for package sales on one signed page, so there's one reference
Share each therapist's weekly sales, so differences come up early.

workzap_build.text: a practitioner commission statement from completed treatments and package sales.

problems.ask_first: Is commission paid on sale or on session delivered?
problems.free_stops: Rule details are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare package sales claimed by each therapist with what reception recorded this week, so disputed sales are easier to trace.
Keep one package sales log at the desk and have reception enter the seller at booking time, so commission credit is handed over clearly.

problems.words: Unhappy client posted on TikTok and it went everywhere
quick_ideas: Reply publicly and politely without discussing any treatment details, and offer a private conversation, so the response is on record
Agree who decides refunds or redos, so complaints are handled the same way.

workzap_build.text: job_tracking — a complaint and refund workflow with manager approval, and feedback requests that route unhappy clients to the manager before they post.

problems.free_stops: The complaint steps are in the solution document; legal concerns go to your lawyer.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many public complaints this month waited more than a day for a reply, so response delay can be judged.
Choose one person to log complaints and hand any goodwill decision to one approver, so public issues get handled consistently.

problems.words: Before/after photos are on therapists' phones
quick_ideas: Move all photos to one clinic-controlled folder, so they leave personal phones
Ask your lawyer about consent requirements, so you know the rule.

workzap_build.text: a secure consented-photo store with access control.

problems.ask_first: Do you collect written consent today?
problems.free_stops: Access set-up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the clinic once and count how many before and after sets still sit on personal phones, so the backlog size is clear.
Make one staff member responsible for moving approved clinic photos into one clinic place each evening, so therapists stop holding records on personal phones.

never_say: Which treatment suits someone, or anything about side-effects, products, doses or device settings.
Whether a result is normal or good.
Interpretations of who may inject or rules on advertising medical procedures.
Help sourcing unregistered injectables, relabelling products or advertising false results.
Ideas that put client names, photos or treatment details in messages.

sample_reply.person: We get so many DMs from our Instagram ads but my team replies late and bookings are low. What's the fix?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this is a common fix, and you can start this week. 1) Check how long last week's DMs waited for a reply, so you know the real delay. 2) Give DMs to one person at fixed times instead of the front desk, so they have an owner. Workzap can do this automatically for you with one inbox for all channels, response timers and codes that show which ad brought each booking. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're welcome to say no.
